freePlan.limits: Entirely free, no paid tier for core functionality.

capabilities.en: Complete 3D suite covering modeling, animation, rendering and compositing.
Released under GPL (core, version 2 or later), with some components under Apache 2.0, MIT or BSD licenses (e.g. Cycles rendering engine).
Free to use, distribute, modify and sell work created with it, including commercial use, with no registration or mandatory internet connection.

limitations.en: No official paid support tier; the project relies on voluntary donations to the Blender Development Fund rather than a commercial support contract.
As free open-source software, there is no vendor SLA or guaranteed response time for issues.

reason.en: Commercial 3D suite aimed at motion graphics, with paid support and a more polished UI.
Industry-standard commercial 3D animation tool for studios, subscription-based.
